summary: Moves the desktop renderer's hand-built overlays onto shadcn/Radix primitives: the provider picker and branch picker onto Popover; the command palette, session picker, search, quick prompt, sidebar text prompt, kanban card and worktree dialogs, the sidebar organizer and Settings onto Dialog. Radix now owns positioning, outside click, Escape, focus trapping and stacking under the in-app confirm; a shared DialogContent returns focus to whatever had it on open, or to the composer. Along the way the kanban card and worktree dialogs get an opaque surface (they painted an undefined var(--bg) and the board showed through), Escape in the provider picker's custom model field and in Settings' launch-config name fields backs out of the field instead of closing the overlay. Each converted component moves its inline styles to Tailwind classes or global.css. The slash-command and @-mention menus are left as they are: they have no focus or dismissal plumbing to replace, and Radix's Escape and outside-pointer handling would fight the Lexical key handling that drives them.

reactNativeIos.reason: Every changed source file is under src/renderer. apps/mobile imports only @shared/* and renders React Native views, which have no DOM for Radix or Tailwind; its pickers and sheets are its own components and no file under apps/mobile changed.

nativeAndroid.reason: apps/android is a Compose app with its own dialogs and pickers; it shares no renderer code, CSS or components with the desktop, and no file under apps/android changed.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No IPC channel, event, wire frame or src/shared file changed. Every overlay calls the same window.api methods with the same arguments as before; only how the overlay opens, closes and takes focus changed.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, settings key or stored data change. Overlay open state stays in React state and is not persisted.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, signing, deep link or update channel change. The two new dependencies (@radix-ui/react-popover, @radix-ui/react-dialog, the latter already in the tree through react-alert-dialog) are bundled into the renderer by Vite; build:fast and its smoke test pass.

automated: npm run typecheck and npm test pass, including provider-picker-models (model filter and grouping moved out of the picker), focus-return (the shared return-focus target for dialogs and the confirm), and tailwind-sources (fails when a Tailwind-styled file is missing from the @source list).

e2e/radix-overlays.e2e.mjs (61 checks) drives every converted overlay in the built app: focus on open, filtering and list keys, Escape closing only the top layer (including a confirm over the card dialog and the organizer's name field), outside click, Cmd+Enter in the card dialog, Tab staying inside, Escape backing out of the custom model and launch-config fields, Space in the session picker, and focus returning to the opener or composer, including after a palette command and after Settings opened from the palette.
e2e/dual-chat-workspace.e2e.mjs passes (55 checks) after being ported from native dialog events to the in-app confirm that #121 introduced; it failed on main before this change.

SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens passed twice in a row. Only the three command-palette baselines changed, on purpose (the old backdrop stretched the palette to its max-height, leaving a blank strip); provider-picker, Settings and every other screen match unchanged in Dark, Light and Translucent.
SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=behaviour (native glass, fullscreen fallback, sidebar organizer and the update-help Escape check) passes on this Mac with Screen Recording permission.
hardware: The new palette baselines, and before/after screenshots of every overlay without a baseline (branch picker, session picker, search, quick prompt, kanban dialogs, organizer), were inspected by eye on this Mac (Apple Silicon) in Dark, Light and Translucent.
notExercised: The sidebar text prompt only opens for renaming a chat on a connected remote machine, which the local fixtures cannot reach; it is covered by typecheck and the shared DialogContent that every other dialog exercises.
Settings moved onto Dialog with its shell styles on Tailwind; the tab bodies (about 1600 lines of forms) keep their inline styles and are left for a separate change.
Mobile and Android were not exercised; no files there changed.
